mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the cooking pot was the most worthwhile moment: the explanation of how its rim keeps it steady made the construction feel practical.

leastWorthwhile.text: Combining the two finished dishes into a feast felt like a predictable intermediate step before placing it on the table.

surprise.text: Iron combined with the stove produced a separate cooking pot before it could be fitted; I had also considered that it might be fitted immediately.

arbitrary.text: Combining porridge and compote into a separate Feast felt a little abstract, though its purpose became clear when it went on the table.
